format: phone-store teacher-forced v1: positions[i] = logits after prompt_ids + ids[0..<i]; top = top-K (id, logit) sorted desc
named_held_format: named[s][L]: the ids the routers named for layer L at step s (sorted; [] when not named); held[s][L]: the experts layer L held when its released choice was made (sorted; prefetch: the masked top-k's table, landed or in flight; exact: before that layer's misses were read)
released_format: released[s]: step s (prompt tokens, then one per fed id) = layers x top-k expert ids, each layer sorted; position i's logits came from step prompt_ids.count - 1 + i
